title: the controls tips name the gun keys as they are now
why: GEARRULES still said Keys 1 to 4 bring up your guns (v21.93) and taught a belt of 1-4 guns, 5-6 throw, 7-8 heal, 9 plate with G, H, U and J (v26.02). The guns are on keys 1 to 8 and 0 now (nine kinds, the rocket launcher on 0, key 9 does nothing) and the rest went to the item wheel (hold Q). The tips now say that, short and lower case. The tip table is not drawn in this build (the full key panel lists keys only), so nothing on screen moves.
now: The controls tips say keys 1 to 8 and 0 bring up your guns and point at the item wheel, not at the old belt keys.
